title: Uwell Caliburn AIR Pod Kit
description:
The
Uwell Caliburn AIR Pod Kit
is an ultra-light refillable pod system built around a 1000mAh battery and 25W maximum output. It is draw-activated with no fire button, and switches between WAVES and STORM output modes by reinserting the pod twice.
Product Type:
Vape Device
Output Power:
Up to 25W
Battery:
1000mAh (built-in, rechargeable)
Charging Port:
USB Type-C (5V/2A)
E-Liquid Capacity:
2mL
Coil Resistance:
0.4Ω / 0.6Ω / 0.9Ω / 1.2Ω
Power Modes:
WAVES (smooth, balanced) · STORM (bold, intense)
Compatible Pods:
Uwell Caliburn GPP Alpha, Uwell Caliburn GPP
Dimensions:
114.05 x 25.5 x 15 mm
Weight:
39g
Kit Contents:
1 x Caliburn AIR device, 1 x 0.6Ω 2mL GPP Alpha replacement pod, 1 x user manual, 1 x child lock instruction card
Brand:
Uwell
Available options: Cloud White, Shadow Black.
